messages:
maria (partnerships): Heads-up — joint demo with Datadog + ApexHW next Tue at 10am PT. Need a concise playbook for tracing + dashboards we can run through in a 30m pre-demo playtest. Can we list the MUST-CHECK items? :clock10:

alex (eng-sre): Must-haves: sampling config, trace->log correlation, span attributes for model and gpu, end-to-end context propagation (client -> proxy -> runtime). Keep it <10 checks so the demo doesn't blow up.

sam (eng-runtime): Also add: verify KV cache spans (cache.hit/cache.miss), batch_size/span_count, and GPU device tags (cuda_device, gpu_mem_used). For model routing traces we need model_id and quantization tags.

jess (obs-liaison): Dashboard quick list: P50/P95 latency by model_id + region, tokens/sec, queue depth, traces with errors, traces sampled rate. One pie/tile showing spans by component (ingest, runtime, gpu). Link to example tiles after playtest.

alex (eng-sre): Quick sampling targets for the demo: overall rate ~0.5%-1% (for demo telemetry), but enable 100% locally for traces you want to inspect. On Datadog side we should verify _trace_sampling_rule_ for our service: service: redwood-runtime, env: demo.

sam (eng-runtime): Example OTEL sampler override we can drop into the demo env (k8s manifest snippet):

```yaml
OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER: parentbased_traceidratio
OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG: 0.01 # 1% for production-like, set 1.0 for capture run
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT: https://intake.datadoghq.com/v1/traces
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS: "DD-API-KEY=${DD_API_KEY}"
```

sam (eng-runtime): Also enable the extra span attributes we discussed: `model_id`, `seq_len`, `batch_size`, `cuda_device`. That makes dashboard grouping useful.

alex (eng-sre): Test commands to generate trace+request id (run from laptop or loadgen):

curl -X POST https://demo.redwood.ai/v1/predict -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Request-Id: demo-$(date +%s)" -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hello"}'

That header should be propagated into logs and span attributes. Verify in Datadog Trace view you can click to logs.

jess (obs-liaison): For dashboards make three tiles: 1) trace-linked latency (P50/P95) by model_id, 2) tokens/sec + throughput heatmap, 3) trace error rate + example trace list. I'll prepare a minimal dashboard JSON we can import into the demo account.

dd-bot: Datadog integration note — OTLP ingest confirmed for demo account. Alerting: create a trace-based alert for error_rate > 1% over 5m. If you need a DD engineer to join the playtest DM @dd-partner-success.

alex (eng-sre): Load test plan: 5m warmup at 10rps, 10m run at 50rps (or scaled down if infra). Capture a 1m 100% tracing snapshot mid-run to collect examples.

sam (eng-runtime): How do we toggle 100% tracing quickly in demo? I can add an admin endpoint: POST /debug/tracing?rate=1.0 or 0.01. Would that be ok?

maria (partnerships): Yes please add that endpoint behind auth. Owners: @alex -> sampling + datadog rule, @sam -> runtime attrs + debug endpoint, @jess -> dashboard JSON + runbook. I'll coordinate ApexHW to provide a small hardware trace sample (nvcc metrics) we can show. :+1:

jess (obs-liaison): I'll also grab a short screenshot flow for the demo: trace -> flamegraph -> linked logs. Keep placeholders for API keys in the runbook.

alex (eng-sre): I'll paste checklist here before EOD so we can run the pre-demo on Monday.

maria (partnerships): Perfect. Thanks team — meeting invite updated. Let's keep the playtest lean. :rocket:
